I am an old woman, 74 years, and this small plot near my house has my enset and some coffee trees that my husband planted long ago. I have no money for the chemical fertilizer from town, and the price keeps going up, so I will just spread the manure from my two cows and the ash from my cooking fire like I always do. The seedlings are from my own plants and my neighbor's — we do not buy seeds for enset and coffee, we use what grows. My grandchildren help me weed and harvest when they come from school, and my daughter-in-law helps too, so I do not need to pay anyone.
